## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b301b37e05bd1798d1e7825938f12d93abafbaee`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/agents/os-dev.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md + AGENTS.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/state-machine.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs (readContainerModelLine), scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs (H50 Thread-read), scripts/check-closing-target-claim.mjs with .github/workflows/closing-target-claim-guard.yml, scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs (GOVERNED_SURFACES), .github/workflows/duplicate-fix-guard.yml, scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs

Inputs: card #25185 body and all three comments (claim 6335635315, the skills seat's waiting note 6339578152, the dev's `os-dev-report` 6340929602); PR #25214 body, file list and the net diff against `main` at the head above (4 files, 29 insertions, 26 deletions by GitHub's count); the 40 check-runs on that head, read at 2026-10-22T12:50Z: every one `success` or an expected `skipped`, none pending, none red. Read-only throughout: diff via the REST diff media type, blobs via `git show` on the fetched head, no checkout, no gate re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

**Card acceptance criteria.** Item 1 (recognise the project environment; `mode:thread` beside `mode:subagent` and `mode:cloud`; the seat keeps claim text, order, contract review, ACCEPT and landing; the thread implements, opens the draft PR and drives CI; disclosure-ruling cards stay in-seat; a card thread counts against `batch`; S/M boundary; coordinator scheduling; order file in the project's shared folder; hand-back in one message, thread stays open for FAIL items) — met in text, see the runbook section 〈卡线程(`mode:thread`)〉 lines 131–147, the SKILL.md `mode:` and `batch:` rows, and `os-dev.md` line 325. Item 2 (effort by difficulty as a field of its own beside the model tier, in the claim's `Container & model:` line and the order; S `medium`, M `high`, L/XL, `security`, p1, the contract review and four-axis analysis `xhigh`, `max` on the maintainer's word) — met verbatim: SKILL.md template line 290 and execution-duties.md lines 118–119. Three of item 1's mechanics are where the FAIL items below sit (claim poster, atomic pair, branch name), and the ruling-thread rule is beyond the card.

**Rule-by-rule, right unless marked:**
- SKILL.md `mode:` row — 「席位是项目线程时 M 及以上、p1、`security` 一律 `thread`」: right, it says what the maintainer's 「同意」 says. Note, not a defect: the row and the card leave an S-mechanical p1 card ambiguous (「S 级机械卡留席内」 vs 「p1 一律 thread」); the seat reads p1 as the override, which is the safer reading. execution-duties.md lines 144–146 (S+M ⇒ subagent; build-heavy ⇒ cloud) carry no project-thread qualifier and are read under the SKILL.md row's.
- SKILL.md `batch:` row counts card threads: right, matches the card.
- Claim template `effort:` field and execution-duties.md 118–119: right. `readContainerModelLine` (dispatch-gates.mjs line 12236) reads the first `model:` token on the line; `mode:` does not match `model`, the trailing `effort:` is not consulted, and this PR's own claim 6335635315 carrying the new shape passed `post-stamped`. `CONTAINER_MODEL_KEY_LINE` still matches.
- Runbook 131–133 (project-thread recognition, S stays in-seat with the stated cost reason, disclosure cards stay in-seat, threads count against `batch`): right.
- Runbook 134–138 (coordinator schedules across seats, p1 first, cap = sum of seat `batch` terms, seats hand candidates at any time, seat frees the slot, maintainer's message attached for model and effort): right against the card. See ③ on the no-state-outside-GitHub line: right only once FAIL 1 is fixed.
- Runbook 139 (seat keeps claim text, order, contract review, ACCEPT, landing; thread implements): right.
- Runbook 140 (order at `/mnt/project-files/SEAT/dispatch-N.md` because a thread cannot read the seat's scratchpad): right, matches the card.
- Runbook 141–142 (claim posted by the thread; 「原子对两笔都由线程执行,先认领后标签」): **wrong — FAIL 1.** Line 134 makes the card thread the dev (「卡线程即 dev」). AGENTS.md (Multi-agent discipline, 「Claim the issue BEFORE you write any code」) says the dispatch sets the assignee (step 1) and posts the `Claim:` (step 2) on the dev's behalf, and that a dispatched executor 「⛔ never writes the card's assignee」; `os-dev.md` rule 2 (「卡 assignee 归 PM … 恒不写卡的 assignee」) and execution-duties.md line 60 (「卡 assignee 归 PM,dev 恒不写」) say the same, and this PR touches both files without reconciling either. Line 142 also reverses the standing order of the pair (execution-duties.md 64–66: assign + `pm:dispatched` first, claim second; line 65's 「step ① 之后获得 assignee 的直接弃出本批」 race depends on that order) without saying which order governs `mode:thread`. The dev's report confirms the thread did write the card's assignee on this very card. AGENTS.md wins over a skill file (AGENTS.md line 7; SKILL.md 优先级), so the skill cannot grant this.
- Runbook 143 (「分支用线程的指定推送分支」): **wrong — FAIL 2.** AGENTS.md discipline §2 (「Name the branch after the issue it fixes: `claude/issue-N-slug`」), `os-dev.md` lines 26, 274 and the report contract's `branch` field (line 366), and the SKILL.md claim template's `Branch:` line all require the issue-named branch; this line directs a name they forbid, and nothing in the PR or the report measures that a card thread cannot push a branch of its own name. The premise behind line 141 (「席位开线程后才知道」 the branch) exists only because of this line.
- Runbook 144 (hand-back message; thread stays open for FAIL): right.
- Runbook 145–146 (a card thread's `needs_decision` goes to a coordinator-opened `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` ruling thread that 「有把握的自裁、落裁决评论」 and sends a decision card only where unsure): **wrong — FAIL 3.** Not on the card: #25185's acceptance text has no ruling thread, and the maintainer's word the PR body quotes for it (「对于这种类似的问题…自己决定，不能决定的开决策卡」) is recorded nowhere on the card — `lanes/director.md` 「裁决只存在于本卡:聊天原话、台账行、他卡引述 ⛔ 都不是裁决」. As written it contradicts SKILL.md line 255 (「总监席是唯一裁决者:决策箱、代裁与一类自裁只出自本席,⛔ 无子代理无自述」) and the 红线 「唯一例外是已裁的代裁通道,不得宽于其置信门」: 「有把握」 is a wider gate than the delegated channel's.
- Runbook 147 (container restarts kill local loops; wait on server-side signals): right, an environment reading stated as a rule.
- execution-duties.md line 92 pointer to the runbook, and the 〈收集〉 line's 「各模式」: right.
- `os-dev.md` line 325 (three modes, GitHub is the report's source of truth): right. The card's expected surface was 「`os-dev.md` where it assumes a subagent」; the places where it assumes the issue-named branch (lines 26, 274, 366) were left as they are, which is correct once FAIL 2 is fixed by keeping that name.

**The 18 deletions, each verified against the head tree — every rule keeps a surviving home; none is a FAIL:** `ensure-pm-labels.sh` → SKILL.md 机械守卫索引 row (line 297); mechanical age alert → SKILL.md `check-half-states.mjs` row (293), the script header being the authority per AGENTS.md; no second label → state-machine.md line 16; ≤5 same-family batch → SKILL.md line 68, and its 「常设授权,⛔ 不逐次请示」 half → triage-duties.md lines 19 and 116; in-flight claims followed by the original claimant → seat-post-protocol.md line 74 and seat-lifecycle.md line 29; reading three → seat-lifecycle.md line 10; mechanical half of the two flags → runbook line 83 kept plus 〈结论当轮执行〉; `os-dev-report` comment delivery → os-dev.md line 17; 「生产侧条款在 os-dev 定义」 was a pointer; replay can look normal → os-dev.md line 330; probe before ready → execution-duties.md line 172; push → draft PR → report, and 「派发令只带增量」 → os-dev.md lines 16–18, 61, 274 and execution-duties.md line 123; three-partition single source → execution-duties.md line 127 and os-dev.md lines 182–184; four-axis block two lines merged into runbook line 211 with both bounds and 「逐字」 kept, per-order fetch kept at line 212; no third copy, stop and ask → os-dev.md lines 356–357 and SKILL.md line 298; model identifier only in content artefacts → AGENTS.md commit-message paragraph and os-dev.md lines 285–286; frontmatter `model:` exemption → os-dev.md lines 12–13 (the gate named there); every work item is a premise to falsify → os-dev.md rule 6; cloud `SendMessage` not-reachable by design → runbook line 124.

**Ratchet.** `CEILINGS` in `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: SKILL.md 319, dispatch-runbook.md 241, execution-duties.md 188, os-dev.md 404. Head counts 319 / 241 / 188 / 404; base counts 319 / 238 / 188 / 404. No ceiling moved and the script is not in the diff. Longest added line 120 bytes (the SKILL.md template line is 290 bytes, but it is a pre-existing line edited in place inside a fenced template, and the other two long lines are pre-existing table rows). Additions paid by deletion, not re-wrap; the one merge is a density fix that keeps content. Right.

**PR body, non-blocking notes for the seat's 终稿:** it says 「21 insertions and 25 deletions」; GitHub counts 29 / 26 (edited lines count on both sides). Two maintainer quotations in the body contain a model name; `check-commit-card-trailers.mjs` judges only the trailer pair and AGENTS.md exempts a verbatim maintainer ruling, so no gate reds, but the seat should keep those quotations as quotation blocks when it writes the record of review.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right. The diff is four files under `.claude/**`, no package moves, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` declared line-initial in the body; `Check Changeset` is green on the label. The tier is `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` because every path hits the Tier S register row `claude-tree` (`GOVERNED_SURFACES`, check-governed-merges.mjs line 1178); head and base repos are both `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, so this is a delivery, not a fork proposal.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **AGENTS.md's 「dispatch posts the Claim」 vs a thread-posted claim — blocks this PR; the fix rides it, no Tier H line is owed.** Option A as the dev states it is not available: the thread also wrote the assignee, which AGENTS.md forbids an executor in so many words, and the sentence is a rule, not prose. Option B is unnecessary once the branch is the seat's to name (flag 4): the order then names `claude/issue-N-slug` exactly as a subagent order does, the seat performs step ① (assign + `pm:dispatched`, drop `pm:queue`) and posts the claim itself before it asks the coordinator, with its own session id (SKILL.md: under one shared identity 「身份看分支」; the thread's own session id lands in the report's `session` field, os-dev.md line 368), and the thread does what AGENTS.md already asks of every executor: verify the newest `Claim:` names its branch, build the worktree on that branch, push it empty, post no second claim. Lines 141–142 are rewritten to that; the card itself left this 「for the PR to settle」.
2. **The coordinator queue vs 「⛔ GitHub 之外永不维护任何跟踪状态」 — blocks as written, cleared by the same fix.** Under lines 141–142 a card handed to the coordinator and waiting for a slot has no GitHub trace at all: it is still `pm:queue`, unassigned, claimable by another seat (the skills seat's note on this card shows cross-seat interest), and a fresh seat session cannot recover the queue. The dev's reading A (「derived from `pm:dispatched` cards and their claims」) is true only when step ① and the claim precede the hand-over; then a waiting card is `pm:dispatched` + assignee + a `Claim:` naming `mode:thread` with no pushed branch yet, which is exactly the 「dispatch's step 1」 state AGENTS.md already names, and the coordinator's slot count is the set of such claims without a merged PR. Order files are inputs, not state — right.
3. **A ruling thread vs the director as sole ruler — blocks as written (FAIL 3); two ways to clear it, the seat's choice.** (a) Rides this PR: line 146 is rewritten so the ruling thread answers only what the seat may already answer — SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉's 不升级类 and the delegated channel within its own confidence gate — files a decision card for everything else, and its conclusions are adopted by the seat after transcript verification (SKILL.md line 75 「子代理裁决逐份过转录核验采信」); the director charter is then untouched and not contradicted. (b) Drop lines 145–146 from this PR (which returns two lines of ratchet budget) and file a skills-lane card carrying the maintainer's quoted word, recorded on that card; a charter change to SKILL.md line 255 or `lanes/director.md` needs that card and the word on it, and the PR body is not a ruling carrier. Either way, this review does not accept a second ruler on confidence alone.
4. **Project-thread branch name vs the Duplicate Fix Guard — the guard is advisory and not the issue; the AGENTS.md §2 naming rule is (FAIL 2), and the fix rides this PR.** Line 143 says the thread names its worktree branch `claude/issue-N-slug` per os-dev.md rule 1 and pushes that; the thread's designated branch is then irrelevant to git, the guard is satisfied, and the claim gate (`check-closing-target-claim.mjs`, green on this head) reads whatever `Branch:` the claim names. A tooling card to teach the guard a `project-thread` prefix is refused unless a measured platform refusal of any other branch name is on record, in which case AGENTS.md §2 is the maintainer's to amend (Tier H) before any skill says otherwise.
5. **Out-of-scope finding 1 (`Thread-read: none (no comments yet)` refused by H50)** — rides: the spelling lives in the seat's own order template, not in the repo; the seat already corrected it; `post-stamped`'s `THREAD_READ_VALUE` accepts one id or `none` and nothing else. No card.
6. **Out-of-scope finding 2 (the harness puts an HTML comment on PR body line 1; os-dev.md 〈干净收尾〉 forbids HTML comments)** — needs a card, skills lane, filed by the seat at ACCEPT (the dev does not file). It is a protocol conflict that recurs on every card thread, and SKILL.md 优先级 says two conflicting rules get a card, not a note; os-dev.md already carries the shape of the exemption for harness-written trailers (line 286, report-not-deviate), and the same one-line exemption for the harness attribution block belongs there, paid under the ratchet. Not blocking this PR; the dev reported it as a deviation, which is the right posture.

**FAIL items, each one line:**
- FAIL 1 — dispatch-runbook.md 141–142: the card thread (the dev, line 134) writes the card's assignee and posts the claim, against AGENTS.md's claim paragraph, os-dev.md rule 2 and execution-duties.md 60/64–66; make step ① and the claim the seat's, before the coordinator is asked.
- FAIL 2 — dispatch-runbook.md 143: the thread's designated push branch replaces `claude/issue-N-slug`, against AGENTS.md discipline §2, os-dev.md 26/274/366 and the claim template; name the branch per convention or record a measured platform refusal and take §2 to the maintainer.
- FAIL 3 — dispatch-runbook.md 145–146: a ruling thread that rules on its own confidence, against SKILL.md 255 and the 红线 confidence gate, on a maintainer word not on the card; scope it to what the seat may answer, or drop it and file the card.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-4nzwyi`
Reviewed-by: `session_01B2EeooonSXrANpkpgUSfFZ`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## 维护者速读

**改了什么:** pm-dispatch 技能加了第三种派发方式 `mode:thread`。席位在 Claude Code 项目线程里跑时，M 及以上、p1、security 的卡每张开一个线程，S 级机械小卡仍用席内子 agent。卡线程由 coordinator 跨席位统一调度，p1 先派，全项目总并发 = 各席 batch 之和。认领和 assignee 仍由席位写：线程开起来先报告自己的分支，等席位发了认领再开工。派单按难度选 effort：S 用 medium，M 用 high；L/XL、p1、security、契约评审和四轴分析用 xhigh；max 只在你点名时用。行数上限没动，靠删掉 18 条在别处已有写明的旧规则抵账。

**为什么改:** 10-22 你在项目里定的几条规则（「此时就每张卡开新线程」「根据任务的难度来选择 effort」「还是需要你来总体调度，因为要优先派 p1」「规则类的应该进仓库」）。

**风险与代价(含回滚):** 纯规则文本，不碰代码和门禁；回滚就是 revert 本 PR。卡线程的分支名 `claude/project-thread-…` 记作实测的平台例外，`claude/issue-N-slug` 仍是约定。

**席位意见:** 建议落地。契约评审第一轮 FAIL 三项，第二轮在本 head 上全部消除，CI 全绿。另外两件事已经另立卡，不随本 PR：你 08:35 定的「裁定线程有把握就自己定」规则是 #25216；harness 在 PR 正文首行写 HTML 注释署名、与 os-dev.md 禁令冲突的问题是 #25220。

**你要做的:** 一件，不急：AGENTS.md §2 要不要写明项目线程只能推指定分支这个例外，或者给卡线程一个推 `claude/issue-N-slug` 的常设许可。改 AGENTS.md 是 H 档，得由你定。
